_note: 學習路徑內容第19批 #5／6：未來完成式 future perfect（eng.t_adv.verb.future-perfect，學測級／高階）。will have + 過去分詞，表未來某時點前已完成；常搭配 by+未來時間或 by the time+子句；否定 won't have + 過去分詞；by the time 子句用現在式（主要子句才用未來完成式）。誘答鎖『have 後用原形、by the time 子句用未來式、混淆現在完成式語意』等唯一正解；P3 誘答全為未來式避開 by the time 子句可用現在完成式的兩可爭議。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix ftp_）。

units.title_zh: 未來完成式（will have + 過去分詞）
units.can_do: 我能用未來完成式（will have + 過去分詞）表達『到未來某個時間點之前，某件事會已經完成』，搭配 by + 時間或 by the time 子句，並知道否定是 won't have、by the time 子句用現在式。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: The future perfect is 'will have + past participle' and shows an action completed before a future point: 'By next week, I will have read the book.'
claims.verification_ref: 未來完成式＝will have + 過去分詞、表未來某點前完成；By next week, I will have read the book；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: It is normally used with 'by + a future time' or 'by the time + clause' to show the deadline: 'By Friday, we will have finished.'
claims.verification_ref: 常搭配 by+未來時間或 by the time+子句以標示截止點；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The negative is 'will not / won't have + past participle': 'They won't have left by six.'
claims.verification_ref: 否定為 won't have + 過去分詞；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: In a 'by the time ...' clause we use the present tense, while the main clause uses the future perfect: 'By the time he comes, I will have cooked dinner.'
claims.verification_ref: by the time 引導的子句用現在式、主要子句用未來完成式；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: The future perfect = will have + past participle. It says that something will already be finished before a point in the future. By next June, I will have graduated.
teach.zh_hint: 未來完成式＝will have + 過去分詞，表示『在未來某個時間點之前，某件事會已經完成』。By next June, I will have graduated.（到明年六月，我將已經畢業。）

teach.body: By next June, I will have graduated from junior high.
teach.zh_hint: 到明年六月，我將已經從國中畢業。will have + 過去分詞 graduated。

teach.body: It often goes with 'by' + a future time, or 'by the time' + a clause, to show the deadline for finishing. By nine o'clock, they will have finished dinner.
teach.zh_hint: 常常搭配 by + 未來時間，或 by the time + 子句，點出『完成的截止點』。By nine o'clock, they will have finished dinner.（到九點，他們將已經吃完晚餐。）

teach.body: By nine o'clock, they will have finished dinner.
teach.zh_hint: 到九點他們已經吃完晚餐。by + 未來時間 標示截止點。

teach.body: The negative is won't have + past participle. Note that the clause after 'by the time' uses the present simple (not 'will'); only the main clause uses the future perfect. By the time you arrive, I will have left.
teach.zh_hint: 否定是 won't have + 過去分詞。注意 by the time 引導的子句用現在式（不用 will），主要子句才用未來完成式。By the time you arrive, I will have left.（等你到的時候，我已經離開了。）

teach.body: By the time you arrive, I will have left.
teach.zh_hint: 等你到時我已離開。by the time 子句用現在式 arrive、主句用 will have left。

practice.stem: 選正確：By next year, she ____ her own business.（到明年她將已經開了自己的公司）

distractor_rationales.will start: will start 只是單純未來，無法表達『到明年之前已經完成』。
distractor_rationales.has started: has started 是現在完成式，講的是現在、不是未來的完成。
distractor_rationales.will have start: will have 後面要用過去分詞 started，不是原形 start。

practice.feedback: will have started：will have + 過去分詞，表未來某點前已完成。

practice.stem: 選正確：____ Friday, we will have finished the project.（到星期五我們將已完成專案）

distractor_rationales.Since: since 用於現在完成式表『從過去某時到現在』，不搭配未來完成式的截止點。
distractor_rationales.For: for 表『持續多久』，不是『截止時間點』。
distractor_rationales.In: in 不與星期幾連用（不說 in Friday）；表『到某時之前完成』用 by。

practice.feedback: By Friday：by + 未來時間，標示完成的截止點。

practice.stem: 選正確：By the time the train ____, we will have bought the tickets.（火車到的時候，我們已經買好票了）

distractor_rationales.will arrive: by the time 引導的子句用現在式，不用 will。
distractor_rationales.will have arrived: 這個子句用簡單現在式 arrives 即可；未來完成式留給主要子句。
distractor_rationales.is going to arrive: is going to 也是未來式的表達，by the time 子句要用現在式 arrives。

practice.feedback: By the time the train arrives…：by the time 子句用現在式，主句用 will have bought。

practice.answer: They won't have arrived by noon.
options: They won't have arrived by noon.
They won't have arrive by noon.
They don't have arrived by noon.

have 後面要用過去分詞 arrived，不是原形 arrive。
否定未來完成式用 won't have，不用 don't have。
要用 won't have + 過去分詞（won't have arrived），不能省略 have。

practice.feedback: won't have arrived：否定＝won't have + 過去分詞。

practice.stem: 'By 2030, scientists will have found a cure.' 這句話的意思最接近？
practice.answer: 到 2030 年之前，科學家會已經找到解藥
options: 到 2030 年之前，科學家會已經找到解藥
科學家現在已經找到解藥了
科學家在 2030 年正在找解藥
科學家過去找到過解藥

distractor_rationales.科學家現在已經找到解藥了: will have found 指未來某時點前完成，不是『現在已完成』（現在完成才是 have found）。
distractor_rationales.科學家在 2030 年正在找解藥: 這是『完成』的意思，不是『正在進行』（正在進行用 will be finding）。
distractor_rationales.科學家過去找到過解藥: 講的是未來 2030 年之前，不是過去。

practice.feedback: will have found＝到未來某點前已經找到，是『未來的完成』。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: By next summer, I will have finished the course.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：By、will have finished（have + 過去分詞）、course、句尾句點。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。by + 時間點稍停、句尾下收。

lines.text: By Friday, I will have read the whole book.
lines.intonation: Friday 後稍停、句尾 book 下收

lines.text: They won't have left by the time we get there.
lines.intonation: won't 稍重、句尾 there 下收
